notes.title: Move, Dodge and Kill demo is live!
notes.notes:
Dodge the enemies shot and kill them with different weapons. Move, Dodge and Kill is a rogue-lite dungeon crawler in a neon environment.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1699500/Move_Dodge_and_Kill/?utm_source=announcement]Click here to test the game![/url]

notes.title: Release V1.0!
notes.notes:
We are so proud to release our very first game! 6 month of hard work to make this little Tower Defense. We hope you will like it!

Don't hesitate to make review and join our discord to discuss about the game.
